name: missing_value
condition: production_tonnes null, or area_ha null, or annual_method == ambiguous_multi_season_no_total

name: yield_zero_encodes_missing
condition: production null and published yield == 0; the contract yield is null

name: first_reported_after_state_start
condition: first source year of (crop, state, district) > first source year of (crop, state); earlier years only

name: method_change
condition: annual_comparability differs from the most recent earlier source year with a row for the same crop, state and district

name: unit_label
condition: a raw season row has unit labels other than Hectare / Tonnes / Tonnes/Hectare

name: duplicate_conflict
condition: a raw season row key (crop, state, district, year, season) is duplicated

name: provider_query_pending
condition: crop Potato, source year 1997-98, state West Bengal or Gujarat (D-48 Option 1); no cause asserted

name: yield_inconsistent
condition: manifest only, per crop: rows with area > 0 and production > 0 (non-null), and max |yield - production/area| / (production/area); no row flag, no tolerance

name: implausible_area
condition: inactive: needs official district/state geographic areas

name: area_jump
condition: inactive: needs a robust reference design

name: boundary_split
condition: inactive: needs LGD / gazette split history
